title: Impact of Semaglutide in Liver Transplant Candidates with Obesity (SOMAL Study): A Prospective Randomized Study.
official: Impact of Semaglutide in Liver Transplant Candidates with Obesity (SOMAL Study): A Prospective Randomized Study.
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy and safety of semaglutide in liver transplant candidates in terms of weight loss and metabolic control.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years.
2. Candidate for a liver transplant (on the active waiting list or being evaluated for inclusion on the list).
3. Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m², or ≥ 27 kg/m² with at least one metabolic comorbidity (type 2 diabetes mellitus with HbA1c <8, high blood pressure, dyslipidaemia).
4. Estimated time on the waiting list sufficient to complete at least 12 weeks of treatment with semaglutide prior to the transplant.
5. The patient or their legal representative must sign the study’s informed consent form.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Absolute contraindication to the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists (personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2).
2. Advanced chronic kidney disease (GFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²).
3. Having received prior treatment with semaglutide within the last 6 months.
4. Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
5. Currently participating in, or having participated in, another clinical trial in the last 30 days.
6. CHILD C liver dysfunction.
7. Upper gastrointestinal haemorrhage due to oesophageal varices.
8. Type 2 diabetes mellitus with HbA1c ≥8.
9. A history of acute or chronic pancreatitis.
10. Documented severe gastroparesis.
11. Severe disease-related malnutrition (according to GLIM criteria) or advanced sarcopenia (assessed by bioimpedance analysis: ASMMI: <5 in women and >7 in men).
12. Plan for a multi-organ transplant (e.g. liver-kidney) or a re-transplant.
13. Haemodynamic instability or an active, uncontrolled infection.
